body.estimand_functional: \(\widehat\theta_N=(NT_N)^{-1}\int_0^{T_N}\{K_{0,N}(t)-K_{1,N}(t)\}\,dt,\quad \sqrt{NT_N}(\widehat\theta_N-\theta_N)\Rightarrow\mathcal N(0,V);\quad \widetilde\theta_N=\vartheta_N(\widehat p;M_N),\quad \sqrt{NT_N}(\widetilde\theta_N-\theta_N)\Rightarrow\mathcal N(0,Q),\quad \sqrt{NT_N}(\widehat\theta_N-\widetilde\theta_N)\Rightarrow\mathcal N(0,W)\), with no upper restriction on \(T_N/N\) for the exact centers.

sampling_model.design: Two equal-sized arms are randomized before monitoring; at every array index each arm contains \(N\) participants, the treatment arm receives implemented capacity \(M_N=\lceil Na+\gamma\sqrt N\rceil\), and the aggregate arm processes evolve independently in stationarity.
sampling_model.units: Each arm contains \(N\) finite-source participants; dependence among treatment participants is induced by shared service capacity.
sampling_model.treatment: Control participants recover naturally at rate \(\tau\); treated participants additionally recover through service at aggregate rate \(\nu\min\{K_{1,N},M_N\}\).
sampling_model.overlap: Randomization identifies the implemented arm contrast; the model-based time-series law conditions on the realized equal arm sizes and capacity.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The rates \((\lambda,\tau,\nu)\) are estimated from marked transition counts divided by at-risk occupation exposures.  Fitted inference evaluates the exact finite-chain stationary product law at those estimated rates while holding the observed capacity fixed; the diffusion expression is reported only through its separate rate-restricted corollary.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: The paper allows distinct fixed arm populations and capacity, proves a fixed-system large-duration occupation limit, and separately gives a many-system fluid limit.
A piecewise Ornstein--Uhlenbeck diffusion approximates a stationary normalized system size in its many-server model.
Prelimit Poisson equations can shift Stein-factor analysis from diffusion derivatives to finite differences for static steady-state approximation.
Mixing triangular arrays admit quantitative functional central limit bounds under stated moment and mixing conditions.
For a fixed countable-state continuous-time Markov chain, Poisson martingales and likelihood-ratio scores admit joint limit theory.
Estimating nuisance parameters by score equations can reduce oracle sandwich variance by a score-projection term in regular estimating-equation models.
Square-root staffing is asymptotically optimal for an open call center under staffing and delay costs.
Queue-informed estimators and confidence intervals improve inference for stochastic-congestion experiments in an open single-server system.
Double machine learning yields efficient inference under conditional shared-state interference.

body.tldr: For equal-arm stationary homogeneous marked-history service experiments, the paper derives a compact-uniform joint occupation-and-rate-score Gaussian law from exact finite-chain Poisson martingales. Evaluating the exact stationary product law at estimated rates while holding implemented capacity fixed gives fitted-center variance \(Q=A^{\mathsf T}\Gamma A\), residual variance \(W=V-Q\), and uniformly valid Wald coverage for arbitrary joint divergence of \(N\) and \(T_N\). The proved kink residual makes the diffusion center an \(O(N^{-1})\)-accurate corollary under \(T_N=o(N)\). For capacity choice, the staffing radius \(G\) is an exact nonnegative rational design datum; explicit energy, tail, transcendental, and split-quadrature bounds construct a sound rational objective oracle on \([-G,G]\), and rational dyadic branch-and-bound returns a finite checkable certificate.

project_justification.gap: The operational-dosage anchor permits distinct fixed arm populations and capacity and gives separate fixed-system occupation and many-system fluid results. It does not furnish the joint critical array law, marked-rate covariance, exact fixed-capacity plug-in inference, or certified critical-capacity optimization proved here for the narrower equal-arm stationary homogeneous subclass.
project_justification.niche: The finite-source birth--death product law makes the implemented finite-system effect exactly computable at candidate rates, while critical capacity creates a piecewise-diffusion score correction and a nontrivial kink. The same piecewise-Gaussian structure admits an explicit global energy modulus and a rational point evaluator whose quadrature is split exactly at the moving kink.
project_justification.fill: The paper proves stationary diffusion and Poisson-energy limits, a primitive martingale joint central limit law, the exact product-law fitted-center Wald theorem without a horizon upper bound, the uniform kink residual, and the diffusion corollary under \(T_N=o(N)\). For an exact supplied rational staffing radius, it also constructs a sound model-specific rational objective oracle with finite receipts; the generic dyadic certificate theorem computes its stopping depth by rational comparison, and uniform diffusion-energy transfer gives \(\epsilon+o(1)\) finite-system regret.

body.related_work: Boutilier, Jonasson, Li, and Yoeli allow distinct fixed arm populations and service capacity and establish separate fixed-system occupation and many-system fluid results. This paper studies the narrower equal-arm stationary compact homogeneous marked-history critical subclass and derives a joint population-duration limit there; it does not claim that positive results transfer upward to the broader anchor class. Braverman and Dai and Braverman inform the piecewise-diffusion and prelimit-Poisson residual methods. Hafouta informs uniform triangular-array reasoning, although the exact martingale proof here needs no upper horizon exponent. Wang and Plechac and Lok inform score--Poisson covariance and projection interpretations; the model-specific fixed-capacity derivative and exact product-law elbow are derived here. Borst, Mandelbaum, and Reiman motivate square-root staffing. The certification layer here is model-specific: it proves the energy modulus, normalizer and tail bounds, rational elementary-function enclosures, and split interval quadrature needed to instantiate the separately proved generic branch-and-bound semantics.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The floating-point witness at \((\lambda,\tau,\nu,\gamma)=(1,1,1,0)\) remains diagnostic rather than a theorem output. Capacity certification requires the planning radius \(G\) to be supplied exactly as a nonnegative rational; the remaining inputs may be supplied by shrinking rational boxes. The constructive proof may refine those boxes, the truncation radius, series orders, quantile bracket, and Darboux partition without a practical worst-case running-time bound. The kink residual is proved uniformly, including kink-crossing jumps and ceiling phases, and \(K_{\mathrm{res}}\) is a proved finite constant. Marked recovery causes, stationary initialization, independent equal-sized arms, homogeneous compactly positive rates, and a bounded critical staffing window remain substantive restrictions.
body.honest_scope: Exact finite-chain fitted centering and empirical inference require only \(N,T_N\to\infty\); no upper relation between duration and enrollment is imposed. The diffusion fitted center differs by \(O_{\mathbb P}(N^{-1})\), so the proved route gives its Wald law under \(T_N/N\to0\). The paper does not claim results for the anchor's unequal-arm class, unmarked histories, common shocks, arbitrary initialization, heterogeneous rates, vanishing-rate boundaries, post-assignment randomization inference, or clinical cure effects. Capacity certification applies to the compact critical-offset objective on \([-G,G]\) when \(G\in\mathbb Q_{\geq0}\) is supplied exactly and the other inputs have rational interval names; it proves termination and finite checkability, not a uniform polynomial complexity bound.
body.interpretation: The exact fitted interval targets the implemented stationary operational effect, not a diffusion estimand: at the true rates the product-law map equals \(\theta_N\) exactly. Same-path rate fitting projects the empirical occupation fluctuation onto the marked rate scores, producing fitted-center variance \(Q\) and empirical-minus-fitted variance \(W=V-Q\). The diffusion center is computationally simpler but inherits \(T_N=o(N)\) from its proved \(O(N^{-1})\) approximation error. For design, an exact rational radius makes the feasible root and its boundary points exactly representable; the constructed rational oracle encloses the limiting capacity--precision objective, the generic certificate theorem terminates after a comparison-defined dyadic depth, and the regret theorem transfers the recommendation to the finite system up to \(\epsilon+o(1)\).
